verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Smart Meetings feature is documented to 'find the best time to meet across all attendees' schedules.' The docs also say Reclaim automatically schedules and reschedules events using priorities, and that Smart Meetings stay movable until they auto-lock at 4am on the day of the meeting, which implies ongoing re-optimization rather than first-slot booking. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how Smart Meetings weighs attendees' calendars and ranks slots, explicit docs on continuous multi-attendee re-optimization, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Smart Meetings.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI finds and continuously optimizes the best meeting time across all attendees' calendars, not just the first open slot

citations.quote: Find the best time to meet across all attendees' schedules.
Reclaim automatically schedules and reschedules events on your calendar, so you don't have to manually adjust your calendar when conflicts come up.
By default, Reclaim will automatically lock your Smart Meetings at 4am in your local timezone at the beginning of the day so that they don't move around the day-of.

Set the priority level for your Habits, Tasks, Smart Meetings, Scheduling Links, and even Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar events from Critical (P1) to Low priority (P4) and Reclaim will auto-schedule your calendar around the things that are most important.
